blocks.text: As Sauron gathers his army, so did he transform into an armored menace as he paves a path of chaos across the Middle-Earth, powered by the One Ring, a new Season 3 trailer of the “Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power” released by Amazon Prime showed. The trailer shows Sauron becoming increasingly indestructible as he creates the Nazgnagôl, precursors of the Nazgul — mortal men like kings and warlords who are corrupted by Sauron to be pepretually enslaved by the Nine Rings of Power before they became ringwraiths.
